### **User description** ## Description This PR implements a robust, accessible 'Card' UI pattern for code blocks on blog posts, ensuring the copy button is always visible and interactive. It also hardens the CI pipeline by fixing ESLint warnings, validating deep accessibility with Playwright (including keyboard interaction and focus management), and resolving Astro Check hints. ## Changes - **Refactor**: Wrapped blog post code blocks in a logical container (Card UI). - **Feat**: Added 'Copy to Clipboard' button with focus/keyboard accessibility. - **Test**: Added `tests/deep.accessibility.spec.ts` for semantic structure, headings, and interactive elements. - **Fix**: Resolved 13+ Astro Check hints and 5+ ESLint warnings (Playwright conditionals). - **CI**: `pnpm verify` is now 100% green (Lint, Build, Test, Security). ## Verification - **Visual**: Verified copy button placement and interaction on local preview. - **Automated**: Playwright E2E tests passed (including robust focus/click checks). - **Static Analysis**: All linters passed. ___ ### **PR Type** Enhancement, Tests ___ ### **Description** - **Astro v6 Migration**: Updated blog post slug handling from `post.slug` to `post.id`, replaced `Astro.site` with `getSiteUrl()` utility throughout the codebase for consistency - **Card UI Pattern for Code Blocks**: Implemented robust, accessible Card UI wrapper for blog post code blocks with integrated copy button, language label, and header - **Copy Button Robustness**: Refactored copy button component with `setupCopyButtons()` function, added `astro:after-swap` event listener for view transition support, and duplicate listener prevention with `data-has-listener` attribute - **Font Management Upgrade**: Replaced manual font imports with Astro's experimental `Font` component for automatic font management - **Event Listener Cleanup**: Added `AbortController` pattern to prevent event listener accumulation across Astro transitions in Header component - **Code Quality & Formatting**: Standardized indentation to 2 spaces, reorganized imports alphabetically, modernized CSS syntax (`rgba()` to `rgb()` with slash notation, media queries to `width >=`/`<=` format), converted opacity values to percentage notation - **Accessibility & Security Enhancements**: Added URL validation with error handling in References component, protocol validation for security, improved semantic structure and focus management - **Utility Functions**: Introduced `sanitize()` utility for safe HTML rendering, `getSiteUrl()` for consistent URL generation, and `safeJsonLd()` for schema serialization - **Custom Element Safety**: Added guard check for custom element registration to prevent duplicate definitions - **Performance Optimization**: Added `contain-intrinsic-size` and `content-visibility` CSS properties, implemented `data-astro-prefetch` attribute for navigation links - **Testing**: Added comprehensive Playwright E2E tests for deep accessibility validation including semantic structure, keyboard interaction, and focus management - **CI/CD Hardening**: Resolved 13+ Astro Check hints and 5+ ESLint warnings; `pnpm verify` pipeline now 100% green (Lint, Build, Test, Security) ___ ### Diagram Walkthrough ```mermaid flowchart LR A["Blog Post Refactoring
post.slug → post.id"] --> B["Card UI Pattern
Code Blocks"] B --> C["Copy Button
with View Transitions"] D["Utility Functions
getSiteUrl, sanitize"] --> E["Consistent URL
Generation"] F["Event Listener
Cleanup"] --> G["Astro Transitions
Support"] H["CSS Modernization
rgba → rgb"] --> I["Code Quality
Standardization"] C --> J["Accessibility
Tests"] E --> J G --> J I --> K["100% Green
CI Pipeline"] J --> K ``` ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **New Features** * Added error page for missing content. * Integrated comprehensive CI dashboard for build and quality metrics. * Enhanced security headers and integrity verification. * **Updates** * Upgraded to Astro v6 with improved content management. * Bumped Node.js requirement to v22. * Improved UI component styling and accessibility. * Expanded documentation for contribution and deployment workflows. * **Infrastructure** * Revamped CI/CD pipeline with unified reporting. * Added asset compression and security optimizations. ✏️ Tip: You can customize this high-level summary in your review settings.
